column1: # mapping_set_title: ISO/IEC 22989:2022 to ISO/IEC 42001:2023 Schema Mappings

# mapping_set_description: Schema-level mappings between the ISO/IEC 22989:2022 (Artificial intelligence concepts and terminology) and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AI Management System) LinkML schemas. ISO/IEC 22989 is the normative terminology reference for ISO/IEC 42001 (see clause 3 of ISO/IEC 42001:2023), so mappings are exact for shared core concepts. This is the inverse of iso42001-to-iso22989.

column10: Both standards model the organization establishing and operating the management system using the harmonised Annex SL definition.
Both standards use the harmonised Annex SL definition of an interested party (stakeholder).
ISO/IEC 22989 is the normative source of the AI system definition used throughout ISO/IEC 42001.
